title: Configuration
description: All configuration options to configure Tablezz.

aiApiKeyFile.description: A file holding the api key for the ai provider, e.g. "~/.secrets/anthropic-api-key". Without it the provider's usual environment variable is used, such as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

aiModel.description: The model ask mode generates SQL with; its name picks the provider, e.g. "claude-opus-5", "gpt-5.4", "gemini-3-pro", "groq::llama-3.3-70b" or an Ollama model.

commandAliases.description: Aliases for long named commands, e.g. { "w": "WriteChanges" }.

editor.description: The terminal editor invoked when editing cells.

keybinds.description: Custom keybinds which trigger predefined commands.

leaderKey.description: The leader key, e.g. "Space" or "Control + a".
